d:
Uttar pradesh men chandrashekhar aajad aur asduddin ovaisi ne 'samajik parivartan morcha' (SPM) banaya hai. kya yah naya gathbandhan dalit-muslim voton ko ekjut kar paega? kya 'bhim-mim' samikran yupi ki rajniti aur 2027 ke vidhanasbha chunavon ko prabhavit karega? janie is nae tisre morche ki sanbhavnaen aur chunautiyan, Talking Politics ke is episod men.
Thank you for watching our video!
